title: S135 later notes: plan note shown, retry context with a queued question

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S135 relay (landed a6d9572), with the owner decision of 2026-10-27: on Retry with a queued sibling owner question while the first pause is not a question, ask the question first; then the retry resumes with that answer in the brief and the retry context (internal/engine/engine.go ~303, queued_questions popped in advance). Also: RunPlan.note (set when RelayRules fails and the plan has no UI or spec-check rows) is not shown in `ork run`'s plan (internal/cli/run.go ~151) or in the TUI launch confirm (internal/tui/launch.go ~309).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first. Retry: when the pending is not a question and queued_questions is non-empty, pop and ask the question first, keep the retry context, and resume with both after the answer. Show the plan note as a dim line under the plan in both views. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine ./internal/cli ./internal/tui; goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
